description: Exposes public channel session telemetry for read-only workflow consumers.
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- Exposes owner-matched channel and worker session telemetry through the public CLI projection.
- Adds the read-only task progress projection used by status integrations.

**Fixes:**
- Keeps existing project configuration and workflow data compatible; no project migration is required.
notes: No project migration is required. Existing projects can run the normal `trellis update` flow.
